title: The D01-S01 HSSC/class correction reached a heading and two REG-BOX rows but not the answer bodies. Six surviving sites in QB3_B q1 and q11, including both spoken layers of q11. RC-01, RC-02, RC-08, RC-09.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Lane-B audit D01-S02 headline finding, which is a direct criticism of this lane's own previous work.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD IN FULL. The previous record's gate asserted the absence of the STRING 'IACS HSSC'. That string genuinely vanished and the commit message's claim was literally true - but the PROPOSITION survived in six sites that never contain the token: 'the IACS Harmonized System of Survey and Certification (HSSC) cycle' with the name spelled out, 'resets the 5-year HSSC clock', 'resets the 5-year HSSC cycle', 'Post-Renewal HSSC Matrix', 'the statutory HSSC intermediate matrix', 'Resetting HSSC Timeline'. Both cards were left CONTRADICTING THEMSELVES - a corrected REG-BOX saying HSSC is a separate statutory regime, and a memorisation-weighted layer saying the class cycle is HSSC. A partial correction is worse than none: it gives the defect an alibi. This is the same failure class as known_traps #101 and #112, reproduced one session after it was documented.
authority: IMO Assembly res. A.1207(34), Survey Guidelines under the HSSC, 2025; the 1988 Protocols to SOLAS and to the Load Lines Convention; IACS UR Z series for the class cycle. For q11's causal claim: a class renewal resets the CLASS period of class (IACS UR Z18 1.1.2-1.1.3, read by Lane B this pass); the statutory certificate cycle is reset by the statutory renewal survey and the reissue of the certificate. Aligned intervals are not a shared clock. For the annual close-up (RC-08): IACS UR Z10.2 governs SINGLE SIDE SKIN bulk carriers, Z10.5 double side skin, Z10.1/Z10.4 oil tankers - verified against the IACS UR index this pass - and cargo hold side shell frames are a single-side-skin structural feature, so the requirement is not an oil tanker one. The 25% extent and the 'forward cargo hold and one other selected hold' scope were corroborated. For RC-09: UR Z18 1.1.2 permits a class extension of up to 3 months beyond the fifth year in exceptional circumstances.
source_gap: IACS UR Z10.2 Rev.37 could NOT be retrieved directly: classnk.or.jp returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch, as it did for Lane B. The AGE BAND that conditions the annual close-up requirement is therefore NOT asserted in the card. The card says so explicitly and tells the candidate to check the clause before quoting a threshold. Section 5 of the instruction requires removal or qualification rather than a guess, and a plausible unverified number is exactly the defect RC-03 punishes.

The matcher was narrowed rather than the content changed. QB3_A#q5 carries a MarineGyaan citation on an unrelated topic - out of scope under section 16, reported not fixed.

cards.what_changed: 60-second answer: 'follows the IACS Harmonized System of Survey and Certification (HSSC) cycle' replaced by the class survey cycle set by Class Rules on the IACS UR Z series, with the statutory HSSC regime named as separate and merely aligned - 'alignment, not a shared clock'. The intermediate is re-stated as at or between the second and third annual survey. The annual close-up bullet is restricted to single side skin bulk carriers, re-attributed to IACS UR Z10.2 with the sister requirements named (Z10.5, Z10.1/Z10.4), the MarineGyaan citation dropped, and the age band explicitly NOT asserted.
